title: Exchange Certificates for an Inductive Approach to Triangle-Free Graph Bipartization
description: Reproducible computational and structural study of an inductive approach to triangle-free graph bipartization. The release includes the preprint, exact checking code, source corpus records, a deterministic 3-for-3 input builder, an independent scope verifier, regression testing, audit output, and SHA-256 checksums. For all 3,436 canonical graph classes in the saved n=15 hard-regime corpus with global L(G)=11, the recorded five-set X admits a 3-for-3 exchange Y with |X ∩ Y|=2 and d(G)-d(G-Y) <= 5. The full Erdős triangle-free bipartization conjecture is not claimed and remains open in general.
